svg.aria-label: Left: a nonlinearity phi(q) in the sector [l, u] lies between the lines p = lq and p = uq. Middle: saturation lies in the sector [0, 1]. Right: on the interval |y| up to a, saturation also lies in the narrower sector [1/a, 1], a local sector condition
